topic: Particle Model of Matter and Scientific Models
key_concepts: Scientists use models to explain phenomena that cannot be easily seen or detected.
Scientific models may be physical, mathematical, or conceptual.
Science relies on evidence, fair testing, logic, and openness to change.

All matter is made up of tiny particles.
Each pure substance has its own kind of particles.
In solids, particles are packed close together.
In gases, particles are spread far apart.
Particles in solids are closer together than particles in liquids.
